goal: 持久化冻结快照、审核元数据和唯一交叉确认关联，复用既有事务状态机。

interface_contracts.name: store input API
interface_contracts.definition: ReviewStore.save_snapshot(snapshot_id:str,payload:JSONValue)->None immutable idempotent equal content; load_snapshot(id)->JSONValue; create_review(round_id:str,state:RoundState,metadata:JSONValue,parent_round_id:str|None=None)->None atomic existing round creation plus round_inputs row referencing snapshot; parent unique and must refer to review input. load_review(round_id)->JSONValue metadata; confirmation_for(parent)->str|None; list_reviews()->tuple[str,...]; set_execution(round_id,seat,attempt,metadata:JSONValue)->None / load_execution(round_id)->JSONValue store runtime preflight metadata. Existing create_round/apply/load_history untouched semantics; new private _insert_round helper. Caller validates boundary inputs; SQL constraints enforce referential integrity, store does not swallow exceptions. Execution metadata immutable/idempotent, FK references actual attempt; load_execution returns seat -> attempt number string -> metadata.

acceptance_criteria: unit/replay：快照同ID同内容幂等，不同内容拒绝；重开后快照/轮次/历史保留，新快照不改变旧报告。
unit：并发连接创建第二个同父确认轮次事务回滚，父不存在拒绝，不留下轮次残片。
unit：从真实v1 schema及历史升级到v2保留全部内容；原迁移版本断言1更新到2并增加新表断言，保留全部事务断言。
replay：failed→retry→late old completion仅历史；至少两快照和一确认轮次可重放，最终状态和历史都断言。
完整verify；没有新增状态/事件/失败类别，转移表无需修改，交付明确说明。
